{{Quote|Sun Leader to Base, please confirm last transmission.|Sun Leader to [[Control Aleph-One]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />}}
This '''Unidentified Sun Leader pilot''' flew a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] and was the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Revos Spaceport]]'s TIE Fighter group.

==History==
{{Quote|Base, copy. Returning home. He had him, Base. Why the change?''"<br />"''New orders. Come on in.''"<br />"''Base, will comply.|Sun Leader to [[Control Aleph-One]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />}}
During [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]], one of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] squadron's objectives was to steal four of [[Revos Spaceport]]'s [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], which were kept in constant readiness in case of an attack. When Wraith [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Hohass Ekwesh]] strafed the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] with his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], it caused an emergency blackout throughout the spaceport. What the Wraiths didn't count on were the two TIE Fighters, piloted by Sun Leader and his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]], that launched and proceeded to pursue Ekwesh.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

Simultaneously, the group of Wraiths [[Garik Loran]] and [[Atril Tabanne]] managed to capture [[Bunker Aleph-One]], the spaceport's command bunker. Pretending to be the [[Control_Aleph-One|controller]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Tabanne, Loran issued the recall command for the TIE Fighters just when Sun Leader's wingman was about to vape Ekwesh's fighter. Upon landing their crafts alongside the other TIE's that didn't launch, Loran's deception was caught and the information was relayed immediately to Sun Leader and his wingman. They tried to relaunch their fighters but were quickly shot down by the other two TIE's; piloted by Wraiths [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Falynn Sandskimmer]].<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />
